name: Learn kendama basics
blurb: A Japanese skill toy with a clear ladder of tricks: big cup, small cup, base cup, spike, and then the airplane. Progress is fast and very visible.
gear: A kendama with a decent tacky finish
steps: Learn the stance and the knee bend — every kendama trick is powered by the legs, not the arms.
Learn big cup: pull the ball up straight and catch it by dipping the knees to absorb the landing.
Learn small cup and base cup, which need the same motion with finer control.
Learn the spike, catching the ball on the point via its hole, which requires controlling the ball’s rotation.
Learn around the world and the airplane, which chain the earlier catches together.
Practise combinations, because linking tricks is a separate skill from doing each one.
tips: Bending the knees to absorb the catch is the whole secret. Stiff arms and legs mean the ball bounces off.
Pull the ball straight up. Any sideways pull makes the catch far harder.
proof: You link big cup, small cup, base cup and spike into one continuous combo.
